performance: session timeline streaming > streams assistant text in v2 with review pane open

interpretation: All assertions completed: 160/160 deltas, zero pending, stable DOM identity, zero blank/drift samples and zero wrong-destination tab transitions.
The median streaming completion times rose approximately 50–57% versus the repaired pre-Chat baseline under CPU throttle 30.
Long-task time and RAF gaps also increased; build time alone does not explain the observation.
The runs used different workers/regions; logs do not establish CPU model or load. No hardware cause or causal code attribution is claimed.

A separate real compatibility defect was identified: the generic app adapter forwarded the active-session envelope instead of its data map. The measured observation does not by itself prove that defect caused the slowdown.
